name: Git Lens
description: GitLens-inspired local Git management for PI-Desktop: status, history, diff, blame, branches, commits and stashes. Docks in the right work panel (no separate window). Human UI only — no agent tools.

en.name: Git Lens
en.description: GitLens-inspired local Git management for PI-Desktop: status, history, diff, blame, branches, commits and stashes. Docks in the right work panel (no separate window). Human UI only — no agent tools.

author: PI-Desktop
changelog: Release 0.2.5: drop agent tools and the Git workflow skill — Git Lens is a human work-panel UI only. Release 0.2.5：去掉 AI 工具和 Git workflow skill，Git Lens 只给人用。 Release 0.2.4: command palette, toasts and the work-panel UI follow the app language (en / zh-CN) from the first paint. Release 0.2.3: compact work-panel UI — overview is a single count row; file/commit diffs open as a full-page sheet with Back. Release 0.2.0: docks only in the right work panel.
safetyNotes: Runs the system git binary (git on PATH) against the repository root resolved from the currently open workspace; the plugin never touches files outside that repository, never passes shell strings (execFile with argument arrays, no shell), never sends network requests, and never reads credentials. Commits, branch switches/deletes and stash operations are local git operations that respect repository hooks; the UI cannot push, pull, fetch or force anything beyond explicit branch deletion (git branch -D only when the caller asks for force). The UI is an isolated, context-isolated work-panel view that talks to the plugin process through the host bridge only. No agent tools are registered.
